meta.association: Heterozygous, usually de novo, variants in the last exon of CCND2 that alter residues around Thr280 (recurrently p.Thr280Asn, p.Thr280Ala and p.Pro281Arg) or truncate the protein before it (p.Lys270*).

evidence.reference_title: A de novo Mutation (p.Gln277X) of Cyclin D2 is Responsible for a Child with Megalencephaly-Polymicrogyria-Polydactyly-Hydrocephalus Syndrome.
evidence.snippet: whole-exome sequencing and Sanger sequencing revealed a de novo nonsense mutation (NM_001759.3: c.829C>T; p.Gln277X) in the CCND2 gene of the patient.

nodes.description: Heterozygous germline variants in the final exon of CCND2 alter conserved residues around Thr280, the residue GSK-3beta phosphorylates to mark cyclin D2 for degradation, or truncate the protein before it. The truncating variants lie in the last exon and are not expected to trigger nonsense-mediated decay, so a stable, shortened protein is made.

nodes.description: Without Thr280 phosphorylation, cyclin D2 is not polyubiquitinated and escapes proteasomal degradation, so the protein accumulates. Upstream PI3K-AKT activation, which inhibits GSK-3beta, produces the same accumulation, making cyclin D2 stabilization the proposed shared step across the MPPH genes.
